summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue general obligation bonds, repaid by property taxes, to fund school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote would authorize the bond measure and its property tax to fund school improvements.
tax.quote: Measure A would cost $47.50 per $100,000 of a property's assessed (not market) value per year while bonds are outstanding.

schools.text: A Yes vote would provide bond funding for improvements to Upland Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: If approved by local voters, Measure A would provide $236.7 million in funding for our community schools to:
